name: Vincamine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Germany and Hungary, first in 1980 — for heart harm and blood problems

summary: Vincamine was removed from the market in Germany and Hungary starting in 1980 due to concerns over damage to the heart and blood harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a low risk score of 28 for liver issues and 40 for heart issues [M]. These estimates rely only on computer calculations rather than actual human studies [M].
